subject.title: Add ambient initiative mode to heartbeat

question: Should OpenClaw core offer an opt-in heartbeat mode that authorizes model-driven proactive outreach, rather than keeping that behavior in explicit agent instructions or an extension surface?
rationale: This is a new user-facing config mode that can initiate outbound messages without a current user turn; code review can assess mechanics but cannot choose the permanent product and safety contract.

options.title: Approve a bounded core mode
options.body: Keep the feature in core, but require enforced send limits, explicit delivery semantics, runner-level tests, and current-head live proof.

options.title: Keep heartbeat task-oriented
options.body: Decline the ambient mode and direct proactive workflows to existing prompt, cron, or extension mechanisms.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Ask for an explicit target, consent, rate-limit, and delivery-policy design before accepting any new config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded core mode
recommendation.body: Keep the feature in core, but require enforced send limits, explicit delivery semantics, runner-level tests, and current-head live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the heartbeat runner and configuration surfaces where the product decision would be implemented.
